text:
Maya (CEO): Morning team — quick weekly from me with a few operational notes and asks.

Maya (CEO): Highlights: 1) Redwood Optimize v1 planned launch Tuesday 09:00 PT — marketing pinged, docs green, please freeze non-critical infra changes until Wed. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/optimize-v1 :tada:

Maya (CEO): 2) Incident recap — last Thursday’s regional scaling incident. Root cause: autoscaler regression hitting a race in pod drain. Impact: ~6 minutes of elevated latency for a subset of dedicated clusters. Full postmortem in #incidents, TL;DR: rollout guard and canary windows were too small.

Maya (CEO): 3) Policy change (small but important) — hosted logs retention default moving from 180 -> 90 days for new customers to reduce cost and compliance surface. Existing customers unchanged; opt-in migration path in the policy doc: https://redwood.internal/policies/log-retention. Ops and sales, please review by EOD Friday.

Maya (CEO): 4) Metrics snapshot: GAU up 12% w/w, p50 latency stable, p95 improved to 210ms on hosted (good), cost per 1k tokens down ~7% thanks to batching/quantization experiments. We still want better tail latency for long-chat workloads.

Maya (CEO): Asks: - Eng infra: validate canary tooling and increase default canary window to 30m for scheduler rollouts. - Product & CS: confirm launch messaging and churn mitigation plan for existing dedicated customers. - Everyone: review the SLA draft (link below) and leave comments by Mon EOD. SLA draft: https://redwood.internal/ops/sla-v2

Ravi (VP Product): Thanks Maya. Product will confirm feature flags and launch checklist by EOD Mon. We'll add a fallback messaging plan for Dedicated customers.

Liam (Head Eng): Infra note: autoscaler patch is merged and will be in canary tonight. We also added additional metrics to detect pod drain races earlier.

Sofia (Dir Ops): Ops will coordinate the DR drill Wednesday 14:00 PT. I'll post a calendar invite and runbook.

Ravi (VP Product): Quick question about log retention opt-in notify — is there an email template or should sales craft custom notes?

Maya (CEO): Sales can draft a short template; make sure legal signs off on the wording. If any group needs support, ping @Sofia.

infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary/infra-autoscaler/2026-03-24T02:00Z -> canary namespace. Monitor: #eng-infra.

Liam (Head Eng): Noted. We'll keep alerts tuned and will rollback automatically if error rate > 1% for 10m.

Maya (CEO): Final: great momentum across product and infra. Keep the cadence on the playbooks and SLAs. Happy to take any questions in the AM all-hands tomorrow. :v:

Sofia (Dir Ops): Will collect sign-offs and publish consolidated feedback doc by Tue COB.

Maya (CEO): Thank you — short and focused this week.
